First release of the TypeScript port of [ens-normalize.js](https://github.com/adraffy/ens-normalize.js) (ENSIP-15), with no runtime dependencies.

Built from the ens-normalize.js spec derived 2025-09-14: Unicode 17.0.0, CLDR 47 (upstream commit `47d8465`). Normalized output and error messages match ens-normalize.js 1.11.1.

## Entry points

| import | exports | min | gzip |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `@adraffy/ens-normalize.ts` | `ensNormalize`, `ensNormalizeFragment` | 22.7 KB | 16.4 KB |
| `@adraffy/ens-normalize.ts/xnf` | same, using the engine's `String.prototype.normalize()` | 17.1 KB | 12.1 KB |
| `@adraffy/ens-normalize.ts/full` | core + `ensSplit`, `ensTokenize`, `ensEmoji`, `isCombiningMark`, `shouldEscape`, `safeStrFromCps`, `nfc`, `nfd`, utils, `ensBuildInfo` | 25.1 KB | 17.7 KB |

For comparison, ens-normalize.js 1.11.1 is 38.3 KB minified (26.1 KB gzip).

## Changes from ens-normalize.js

- **camelCase names**, for example `ens_normalize` is now `ensNormalize`.
- **`ens_beautify`** is now `ensNormalize(name, { beautify: true })`.
- **`ensTokenize`** returns `{ input, tokens }`. Every token has `start`/`end` into `input` and its `output`. Emoji tokens add `beautified`; nfc tokens add `before` and `after`.
- **`versions`** is now `ensBuildInfo`.
- **`ensSplit` labels** add `restricted`. `emoji` is `false` instead of `undefined` for text-only labels.
- **Errors** for names with more than one label keep the original error as `cause`.
- **Emoji tokens** are plain arrays, with no `Array` subclass, so they work on engines like Hermes.

## Verification

- All 38,614 ENSIP-15 validation tests and Unicode's NormalizationTest pass in every bundle (ESM and CJS).
- Outputs match 1.11.1 for every API, checked against a fixture generated from that version.
- Browser tests: https://adraffy.github.io/ens-normalize.ts/
